code: local f=workspace.Phase1Map.town1.Church local o={} for _,m in ipairs(f:GetChildren()) do if m:IsA('Model') then local cf,sz=m:GetBoundingBox() local lv=m:GetPivot().LookVector table.insert(o,string.format('%s at (%.1f,%.1f,%.1f) size(%.0f,%.0f,%.0f) look(%.2f,%.2f)',m.Name,cf.X,cf.Y,cf.Z,sz.X,sz.Y,sz.Z,lv.X,lv.Z)) end end local sp=workspace:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('SpawnLocation',true) table.insert(o,'spawn '..tostring(sp.Position)) local near={} for _,d in ipairs(workspace.SpawnTown:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA('Model') and d.Parent:IsA('Folder') then local cf,sz=d:GetBoundingBox() if math.abs(cf.X+210)<130 and math.abs(cf.Z-215)<110 then table.insert(near,string.format('%s(%.0f,%.0f %.0fx%.0f)',d.Name,cf.X,cf.Z,sz.X,sz.Z)) end end end table.insert(o,'near: '..table.concat(near,' ')) return table.concat(o,'\n')
